tags.description: List of tag names to assign to this customer. Names must contain only lowercase letters, numbers, and dashes (e.g. "annual-member", "vip"). Maximum 25 tags. This is a replace operation — the provided list becomes the full set of tags. Omitting this field leaves existing tags unchanged. This field cannot be combined with `add_tags` or `remove_tags`. To change tags and keep the customer's other tags, use `add_tags` instead.
tags.title: Tags

add_tags.description:
Tag names to add to this customer. Tags already on the customer stay. A name that the store does not have yet creates the tag, with the same name rules as `tags`. A name the customer already has does nothing. Maximum 25 names.

Each added tag starts the published automations with a Tag added trigger that matches it. An automation that matches any tag starts too, so a misspelled name creates a new tag and starts those automations.

Integrations that run next to automations should use `add_tags`, not `tags`. For example, an automation adds a tag to the customer, and a moment later an update with `tags` removes it, because the list that the integration sends does not contain that tag. `add_tags` changes only the listed tags.

A request returns 422 when the same name is in `add_tags` and `remove_tags`, or when the value is not an array of strings. Every tag error comes under the `tags` key of the error object.
add_tags.title: Add Tags

remove_tags.description:
Tag names to remove from this customer. The customer's other tags stay. A name the customer does not have does nothing. Maximum 25 names.

A request returns 422 when the same name is in `add_tags` and `remove_tags`, or when the value is not an array of strings. Every tag error comes under the `tags` key of the error object.
remove_tags.title: Remove Tags

unsubscribed_topic_ids.description:
Email topic ids to unsubscribe this customer from (see GET /email_topics). Unlike `tags`, this is NOT a replace operation — it only ever unsubscribes. Topics left out of the list keep their current state, and re-sending an id the customer is already unsubscribed from does nothing. An empty list and an omitted field are both no-ops.

This field cannot re-subscribe a customer: resubscribing is the customer's own act, performed from their email preferences page. Values that are not whole numbers, and ids that do not belong to an active topic of this store, are rejected with a 422.

To opt a customer out of all marketing email instead, send `opted_in_for_news_and_updates: false`.
unsubscribed_topic_ids.title: Unsubscribed Topic Ids
